productConcept.name: FORMFACTOR
productConcept.description: Precision structural load-testing instruments — specifically the FF-9 Series Static Load Frame, manufactured in Sheffield for materials engineers, civil laboratories, and research facilities.
productConcept.rationale: The oxide-night design system's near-black #19191c background, pink-red #fd356e accent used sparingly, Fraunces 700-900 display type, staccato 0.1s motion, and asymmetric 80px/20px grid demanded a heavy industrial product. FORMFACTOR is precision testing instruments — machined, serious, calibrated to Class 0.5. Nothing archival, nothing craft. The instrument category (structural load testing) maps perfectly to the design's noir editorial register: weight, precision, cold accuracy. Avoids all product concepts in the avoidance list.
